values.note: Full hookup $45.99 plus tax a night, $210.99 a week; water/electric $29.99 is for pop-up campers only; tents $15 a person (+$10 for electric). Monthly $500 dirt / $550 concrete plus electricity and a $150 deposit; units over 10 years old must be inspected.

fees.source: http://www.rockyscampground.com/campground/ (Fees: 'Water/Electric: (only for pop-up campers) $29.99 + tax per night', 'Full hook -up: $45.99 + tax per night / $210.99 + tax per week', 'Monthly – Concrete Site: $550 or Dirt Site $500 plus $150.00 deposit'; the page embeds files uploaded 2024-09 and 2025-09), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: http://www.rockyscampground.com/about-us/ ('Grassy pull through sites, which all have full water and electric hook ups (50/30/20 amp service)', '34 full hook-up sites (50/30/20 amp service)') + http://www.rockyscampground.com/campground/ ('Water and Sewer must be positively connected'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 34 grassy full-hookup sites (concrete and dirt), plus a primitive tent section. Two vehicles per site; extra parking across from the store.

sites.source: http://www.rockyscampground.com/about-us/ ('34 full hook-up sites', 'Grassy pull through sites', 'has a section for tents') + http://www.rockyscampground.com/campground/ ('Monthly – Concrete Site ... or Dirt Site', 'No more than two vehicles per site – extra parking is available across from Rocky's'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: New large bathhouse. The convenience store next door has a breakfast/lunch deli, fuel, ice, bait and hunting/fishing supplies. Game-cleaning area.

facilities.source: http://www.rockyscampground.com/about-us/ ('We have a very accessible dump station, washer & dryers, and a New large bathhouse', 'Rocky's Convenience Store is located next to the Campground and offers breakfast/lunch daily') + http://www.rockyscampground.com/campground/ ('Cleaning of wild game/fish is welcomed in the designated area'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve by phone (850-584-6600); register and pay at the store on arrival. Rented by the night, week or month.

booking.source: http://www.rockyscampground.com/about-us/ ('Call today to make reservations. 850-584-6600') + http://www.rockyscampground.com/campground/ ('All campers, visitors and guest must be registered at the store upon arrival', 'Rent by the night, week or month'), read 2026-10-21

note: Roadside RV campground on US-98 four miles west of Perry (Taylor County), beside Rocky's convenience store and deli; a popular overnight and scalloping/hunting-season stopover. The website loads over http only (https gives a self-signed certificate, 2026-10-21). --Claude
